metadata.label_value_policy: V2 default evaluates one anonymous-worker canonical labeling. Use --check-label-invariance to evaluate all four same-color worker labelings.
metadata.ranking: Player 2 responses sort by value_mean ascending. Player 1 choices sort by minimax_value descending.
metadata.recommended_use: Use high-minimax openings for strong-player-like self-play sampling. For arena suites, sample from this book while filtering out very lopsided values, then play each selected opening once from each side.
metadata.symmetry: Player 1 choices are D4-canonical; Player 2 responses are canonical under symmetries that preserve Player 1's placement.
metadata.value_perspective: player +1 after both players have placed workers
